subject: english
options: A coffee is all coffee; the coffee means none.
Coffee and the coffee can never differ.
I like coffee; the coffee in this cup is cold.
I like the coffee everywhere; coffee in this cup is the.

optionRationales.reason: A coffee is all coffee; the coffee means none.：冠詞意義說反。
Coffee and the coffee can never differ.：一般與特定指涉可以不同。
I like coffee; the coffee in this cup is cold.：前者談咖啡一般，後者由 in this cup 限定。
I like the coffee everywhere; coffee in this cup is the.：限定與語序錯誤。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「在複數或不可數名詞表一般類別、專有名詞與固定制度性用法時辨識零冠詞，並與特定 the 用法對比。」可推出 I like coffee; the coffee in this cup is cold.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 I like coffee; the coffee in this cup is cold. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
